analysis.session_summary: The full trading day saw the dollar close at its best, with USD strength_pct +0.392 and DXY +0.807 despite an ISM manufacturing miss that printed 54.5 vs 54.8 forecast. CHF outperformed as the top currency, rising +0.759 strength_pct after SNB Chairman Schlegel spoke, while EUR was weakest at -0.676 strength_pct. The ISM reaction was inverted: the USD strengthened 0.102% on the miss, indicating crowded short-USD positioning. High-beta and European FX were sold, with EUR/USD closing at 1.12186, down 120.2 pips, and VIX up 3.383%.

themes.evidence: ISM Manufacturing PMI missed at 54.5 vs 54.8 forecast, yet USD strengthened 0.102% and DXY closed +0.807%.

themes.evidence: CHF was top with +0.759 strength_pct and USD/CHF fell 30.6 pips to 0.83206; SNB Schlegel speech produced CHF stronger by 0.078%.

themes.theme: High-beta and European FX under pressure into NFP
themes.evidence: EUR was weakest at -0.676 strength_pct; AUD, GBP, NZD all closed lower with attempt-rejected shapes against USD.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Three legs: down -70.1 pips, up 34.1 pips, then down -85.6 pips with SNB Schlegel contributing only 17% of the final leg (-14.7 pips), leaving the first two legs without clear catalysts.

polarity_reads.read: A miss surprise (54.5 vs 54.8) produced USD strength of 0.102%, opposite the textbook sign; this implies positioning was skewed short USD or long risk, so bad data triggered covering.
CHF strengthened 0.078% despite no forecast to score; the broad CHF bid against EUR and USD shows markets leaning CHF-positive regardless of specific policy signal.
